_about: The lift operator's outdoor pedestal with a phone (task 4.50 phase 4; bldgkit/op_pedestal.py builds it; owner 2026-11-24). A steel post with a control head (stop and slow buttons) and a weatherproof phone box, standing on the unload ramp's hut bay beside the unload point (the ramp's `pedestal` socket). Our own design: no maker's name or mark on it. Frame in the builder's docstring. Millimetres.
